related.title: MISP Warning Lists：誤報提示與人工判斷
related.titleEn: MISP Warning Lists: false-positive warnings and analyst judgment
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付100指標狀態表、60個可用集合、時間邊界測試與本地重評政策。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver one hundred indicator statuses, the sixty-item usable set, time-boundary tests and local reassessment policy.
related.difference: 保留指標來源、清單版本與命中原因，將warning視為待判斷提示而非自動允許或自動惡意。
related.differenceEn: Retain indicator source, list version and match reason, treating warnings as review prompts rather than automatic benign or malicious labels.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可用集合=在有效時窗內且未撤銷且來源政策允許的指標；新近修改不會自動延長有效期。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100個合成指標中70個在有效期內，這70個中5個已撤銷、另5個來源不符本地政策。 可用70−5−5=60個，即60%。
需情境審查比例=唯一warning命中指標/唯一輸入指標；多清單重複命中只算一次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 200個唯一合成指標，清單A命中30個、B命中25個，重疊10個。 唯一warning命中30+25−10=45個，審查比例22.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Usable indicators must be in their validity window, not revoked, and allowed by source policy; modification time does not automatically extend validity. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of one hundred synthetic indicators, seventy are within validity; five of those are revoked and another five fail local source policy. Usable count=70−5−5=60, or 60%.

Context-review fraction counts unique warned indicators over unique inputs; repeated list matches count once. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two hundred unique synthetic indicators yield thirty matches in list A and twenty-five in B, with ten overlapping. Unique warned indicators=30+25−10=45, giving 22.5% requiring context review.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Restic：資料讀回、雜湊與可用復原
related.titleEn: Restic: reading backup data and proving usable restores
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付100指標狀態表、60個可用集合、時間邊界測試與本地重評政策。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver one hundred indicator statuses, the sixty-item usable set, time-boundary tests and local reassessment policy.
related.difference: 用自編文字檔建立測試備份，保存snapshot識別與原檔摘要，再復原到全新目錄核對。
related.differenceEn: Create a test backup of original text files, retain snapshot ID and source hashes, and restore into a new directory for comparison.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可用集合=在有效時窗內且未撤銷且來源政策允許的指標；新近修改不會自動延長有效期。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100個合成指標中70個在有效期內，這70個中5個已撤銷、另5個來源不符本地政策。 可用70−5−5=60個，即60%。
全資料讀回時間下界=資料量/有效讀取速率；抽樣只覆蓋被讀到部分，不能宣稱其餘必然完整。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 測試儲存庫有10個各100MB資料包，讀取速率50MB/秒；不計解密與延遲成本。 全讀回1000/50=20秒；只讀2包為200/50=4秒，僅20%資料量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Usable indicators must be in their validity window, not revoked, and allowed by source policy; modification time does not automatically extend validity. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of one hundred synthetic indicators, seventy are within validity; five of those are revoked and another five fail local source policy. Usable count=70−5−5=60, or 60%.

Full-data read lower bound is data size divided by effective read rate; sampling proves only the sampled portion. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A test repository contains ten 100 MB packs read at 50 MB/s, excluding decryption and latency overhead. Full readback takes at least twenty seconds; two packs take four seconds and cover only 20% of bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
